notes: Gap-closure alignment car 1 (task 2 gap-closure D1-D4): project context files, file checkpoints + rollback, skills frontmatter compatibility, multi-upstream model failover. (1) D1 context files: opt-in project context dirs — env AIDOG_CONTEXT_DIRS > CONSOLE settings mycore.context_dirs > off (default off, existing stack byte-identical) — inject AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.local.md in name order as system messages with a [project context] provenance header, present-only (a project without these files adds nothing and never a notice), per-file 8000-char cap with the honest truncation marker; wired into every turn path (cli, service chat, cron-prompt leg, console chat). (2) D2 checkpoints: new mycore/checkpoint.py snapshots the PREVIOUS bytes before write_file/edit_file mutate a file into <state>/checkpoints (append-only JSONL index mapping id -> path/size/sha256/ts, raw-byte snapshot files for byte-exact restore, 100-entry rotation with file unlink, 1 MiB per-file cap); the write result names its checkpoint (· checkpoint #N) and an existing file that could not be snapshotted says so; snapshot failures never block a write (fail-soft), restore fails loud (unknown id / missing / sha256 mismatch are refused honestly); restore snapshots the current content first so a rollback is itself undoable; surfaces = /checkpoint list + /checkpoint restore <id> service command (en/zh locale keys, /help entry, repo-relative path scrubbing) and the ops CLI python3 -m mycore.checkpoint --list|--restore (exit 0/1/2); run_bash mutations are explicitly out of coverage. (3) D3 skills frontmatter: conservative YAML-subset parser in lib/skill_route.py (quoted values, block scalars, cross-line quotes, unknown fields tolerated, top-level keys only) so agentskills.io-format skill headers load; present-only license/allowed-tools/version flattened onto --json hits; multi-line description enters the routing corpus in full; router suite 15 -> 30. (4) D4 modeltier Tier C v1 closes the post-swap backlog item: ordered chain = primary base_url then mycore.upstreams (env MYCORE_UPSTREAMS > settings > off, entries url[|key_env[|model]], <=4, <=1024 chars); one attempt per upstream (same-URL fail-fast), payload-class errors (HTTP 400/405/413/415/422) fail immediately because every upstream would reject the same request, everything else (transport, 401/403/404/408/429/5xx, malformed body) moves to the next upstream, and a failure after the first streamed delta is never replayed (no duplicated output); the credential pool stores ENV SLOT NAMES only (values read per attempt, never stored/logged/echoed); an invalid spec turns the chain off and reports the reason through ModelConfig.describe() (upstreams-invalid: ...), the settings validator returns the parser's exact reason, and the console Fallback chain card now reflects mycore.upstreams; the loop's honest stop note now surfaces the vetted ModelError text so a failover-chain exhaustion diagnosis reaches the reply. NOT in v1 (stated up front): queue dual-tier timeouts 30s/300s, 60s capacity backoff, per-key health scoring, protocol adaptation — they need a real multi-provider fleet to tune. (5) Console/settings: mycore context_dirs + upstreams keys (single line, empty = off, control chars rejected) in MYCORE_KEYS + settings.example.json; suite hermeticity: the mycore suite pins AIDOG_MC_STATE to a throwaway dir so default-state tools stop writing into the production data/ tree. (6) Docs: new docs/features/context_files.md, checkpoints.md, model_failover.md; PRODUCT_HANDOFF gains four feature rows and the module inventory is now 14 modules ~3.5k LOC (checkpoint.py + modeltier.py); competitive doc line refs re-anchored after the inserts. Frontend untouched (owner freeze).
